title: Structured Logging You Can Actually Query
objective: Design a structured log schema with correlation identifiers for one real request path, and prove it answers specific operational questions.
whyThisMatters: Unstructured, inconsistent log lines are unreadable at scale. A defined schema with correlation ids is the foundation everything else in this term (dashboards, traces, alerts) is built on top of.
evidence: A log schema note naming each field and its meaning
A log excerpt showing the full correlation-id chain for one request
The three named operational queries plus their captured output
A written redaction rule with a before/after example line
Reflection notes answering the task questions
acceptanceCriteria: Every log line for the demonstrated request path parses as valid structured data (JSON or a documented key=value format).
All log lines from one request share one identical correlation id value, shown across at least three lines.
Each of the three named operational questions has a corresponding query and its captured output.
No line in the submitted log sample contains a raw password, API key, token, or personal secret value.
